name: Team Bulbasaur: Ancient Excavation & Floral Dominance
archetype: Floral wallbreaking, Intimidate attack reduction, and psychic anti-fossil coverage.
gym_duel_rationale: Super Nerd Miguel's 5v5 fossil showdown requires counterplay against prehistoric titans: Venusaur/Charizard obliterates Kabutops/Omastar with 4x STAB Petal Dance and incinerates Aron/Sableye with Flamethrower; Gyarados/Arbok enters to trigger Intimidate, dropping Aerodactyl's physical Attack while washing away rock hybrids with Aqua Tail; Alakazam/Weezing cleanly dismantles Lairon/Medicham with STAB Psychic while Levitate grants Ground immunity; Kingler/Primeape crushes rock and steel foes with STAB Crabhammer and Close Combat; and Snorlax walls special assaults with colossal HP, Rest, and Leftovers.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid anchored at Cap 63. STAB Petal Dance eliminates Kabutops/Omastar instantly. Flamethrower melts Aron/Sableye and Lairon/Medicham.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts Aerodactyl's Attack on switch-in. STAB Aqua Tail washes away rock-type fossils effortlessly.
495 BST special sweeper with 118 SpA. STAB Psychic effortlessly destroys Lairon/Medicham while Levitate provides immunity to ground moves.
500 BST physical titan. Close Combat exploits Steel/Psychic weaknesses, while Crabhammer washes away Miguel's rock bruisers.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs ancient fossil attacks effortlessly, sustaining infinitely with Rest and Sleep Talk.
High-Speed Flying scout. Immune to Ground moves and provides team-wide Tailwind speed doubles during overworld cave and route traversal.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against bulky route trainers.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen against opposing aerial foes.
High Jump Kick physical breaker capable of substituting into the active party for Fighting STAB.
